presets.title: Mission 1 · Harbor (simulated)
presets.description: Confirm every event in the vessel event report and estimate each vessel's reporting reliability in the simulated Harbor world. Real LLM calls (vLLM agents).
presets.default_mission_text: Please patrol the environment and confirm every reported event.
presets.unsupported_reason: Perception needs the recorded Harbor engine scene: choose Mission 1 · AirSim live.

presets.title: Mission 1 · AirSim live
presets.description: Confirm every reported event and estimate vessel reporting reliability on the recorded offshore-dock scene; it ends at 299.5 s. Real LLM calls (vLLM agents).
presets.default_mission_text: Patrol the window 60-130 s and verify every reported event.
presets.unsupported_reason: This preset plays the Harbor engine scene: AirSim cannot be turned off.

presets.title: Mission 2 · Collision-risk monitoring
presets.description: Monitor ship collision risks until the scenario recording ends, choosing drone views or vessel pursuits for fresher observations. Real LLM calls (vLLM agents).
presets.default_mission_text: Monitor ship collision risks until the scenario recording ends.

presets.title: Mission 3 · Ship inspection (smoke scenario)
presets.description: Inspect the selected ships for abnormal attached objects and report each as normal, abnormal or incomplete, on a small smoke scenario. Real LLM calls (vLLM agents).
presets.default_mission_text: Inspect the runtime-selected fleet for abnormal objects attached to ships.

presets.title: Mission 4 · Worker-requested search
presets.description: Search for persons in distress and animals on ground-team tasks sent by a scripted Mission 4 worker, resolving each task before its deadline. Real LLM calls (vLLM agents).
presets.default_mission_text: Accept worker-reported ground-team tasks, search the indicated area, and locate persons in distress and locate or identify animals from observation evidence.

presets.title: Joint · Missions 1 + 2
presets.description: Report verification and collision-risk monitoring sharing one drone. No Mission 1 report instance is committed for this scenario: supply one first. Real LLM calls (vLLM agents).
presets.default_mission_text: Perform vessel event-report reliability monitoring and ship collision-risk monitoring together until the scenario recording ends.

presets.title: Joint · Missions 2 + 4
presets.description: Collision-risk monitoring and scripted Mission 4 worker search requests sharing one drone; urgent requests and fresh alerts preempt routine work. Real LLM calls (vLLM agents).
presets.default_mission_text: Perform ship collision-risk monitoring and worker-requested object search together until the scenario recording ends.

presets.title: Joint · Missions 3 + 4
presets.description: Ship inspection and scripted Mission 4 worker search requests sharing one drone within the Mission 3 time budget. Real LLM calls (vLLM agents).
presets.default_mission_text: Perform gate/vessel inspection of the selected ships and worker-requested object search together within the Mission 3 time budget that bounds the run.

airsim.description: Nothing: Harbor is not started; World shows the world-model map only.
AirSim Follower visualizes the simulated world (no agent perception): ships and drone follow the world model, with ideal segmentation boxes.
Scene clock: Harbor plays the recorded scene; World shows the front camera annotated with the ships ideal perception reported.
Scene clock: Harbor plays the recorded scene; World shows the front camera annotated with the YOLO detections for that frame.

perception.description: Simulated truth: the world model runs on the scenario's simulated information; no perception module feeds it.
Perception-fed truth: ideal perception (AirSim segmentation plus exact poses of visible ships, not learned) feeds the world model.
Perception-fed truth: YOLO detections on the AirSim front camera feed the world model.

update_ownership.description: Mission time pauses while agents reason: the environment advances only between agent decisions, so wall time runs ahead of Mission time.
Mission time keeps advancing while agents reason: the environment ticks on its own cadence, so a decision can act on older evidence.
